Combine compatible rules with all necessary supportChoose a winner among an unresolved ConflictSet
Explain typed authority/treatment findings from L5Call a case binding, controlling, overruled or good law from prose alone
Describe a source-backed procedure neutrallyCalculate fees, limitation, shares, forum or clauses assigned to deterministic L5 services
Identify missing facts and official coverage gapsTurn corpus silence into “no law exists” or fill a gap from model memory

8.1Information, not representation

The Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973 reserves practice of law to advocates. This product therefore adopts a conservative information boundary, without pretending that the statute alone conclusively classifies every automated explanation. Launch requires Pakistani counsel review. The output register is “the law provides” and “the source states,” not personalized commands, tactics, document-signing approval or advocate impersonation.

A structural, non-dismissible disclaimer states jurisdiction/date, corpus coverage, that facts were not independently verified, and that the output is legal information rather than representation. Wording in English and Urdu is approved and versioned by counsel. It is never model-authored and never treated as a substitute for correct output.

8.2Escalation

Escalate for arrest/liberty/bail, an imminent filing/appeal/limitation date, violence or immediate safety, eviction, irreversible waiver/transfer, child/family status, constitutional validity, unresolved forum/jurisdiction, contrary authority, incomplete delegated law/commencement/treatment coverage, or a request for representation/tactics. Return why human review matters, what material is present/missing, useful dates/documents to gather, and a curated official legal-aid/advocate route. Contact links are maintained data, never generated.

8.3Bilingual equivalence

English and native Urdu are two renderings of the same proposition IDs, evidence relations, modality and caveats. Enacted English text remains verbatim and visibly distinct; Urdu is labelled explanation unless an authentic Urdu source exists. XNLI Urdu is only a generic checkpoint smoke test. Shipping requires lawyer-labelled Pakistani legal claim/span parity, including shall/may, negation, provisos, dates and mixed-script citations. Roman Urdu is accepted at L3; L4 returns native Urdu rather than unstable Roman legal prose.

§9Cache &
offline tier

Reuse proof, not merely similar prose

9.1Three different caches

  • Provider prefix cache: a billing/latency optimization for static policy, schema and examples; no correctness semantics.
  • Exact verified-artifact cache: reuse only when query intent/scope, exact dates, evidence/context fingerprint, conflict/coverage findings, language/register and every pipeline version match.
  • Curated answer tier: batch-generated, fully verified artifacts admitted to the signed offline pack; current dependency checks and release review required.

A semantic nearest match may nominate an artifact, but it never authorizes reuse. Require semantic-equivalence confirmation, exact legal-scope equality, live dependency fingerprint and locked-set cache precision ≥0.95. Disable semantic reuse for precedent/conflict, limitation, liberty/custody and other high-risk scenarios until separately proven safe. Show the canonical matched question and corpus/build date.

9.2Required L2 correction

The current stored_answer.cited_provisions[] and one global verifier_score cannot express judgment/schedule dependencies or per-claim proof. Normalize answer_dependency, answer_claim, answer_claim_evidence, verification_result and artifact_invalidation. Publication invalidates affected artifacts in the same transaction. The offline tier admits only all-pass blocks; online uncertainty appears only as explicit coverage limits.

§10Audit
& privacy

Store the evidence of the answer

RecordMinimum contentPurpose
generation_runRequest/retrieval refs, task/scope, context digest, provider/model snapshot and parameters, token/cost/latency, statusOperational replay and cost
prompt_artifactContent-addressed complete compiled prompt, schema/policy versions; encrypted or restricted blob referenceA hash alone cannot reconstruct a prompt
provider_completionRaw structured response or restricted reference, digest, finish/refusal reasonExact byte replay despite provider drift
answer_artifactFinal verified payload, artifact digest, invalidation stateImmutable served answer
claim + evidenceAtomic claim, materiality, source/version/offset relationsNormalized provenance and impact analysis
verification_resultTier, model/threshold, score/verdict/reason per claimAudit, calibration and debugging

Conceptually this forms a W3C PROV-style graph: evidence/prompt/answer are entities; retrieve/generate/verify/render are activities; providers/models/curators are agents; each artifact is explicitly derived from its inputs. MVP keeps relational tables rather than introducing RDF.

10.1Anonymous mode

No user ID, query, prompt/provider body, answer body, cache insertion, analytics content or durable generation row. Keep only ephemeral in-memory state and content-free operational counters, then destroy them. OpenTelemetry spans never contain query/evidence/answer text; GenAI semantic conventions are still evolving, so the project pins its own stable, content-free attributes.

10.2Report and incident loop

A report carries answerId/requestId into a review queue with the exact artifact, claim/evidence graph and verifier trace. A reviewer can invalidate an artifact immediately, classify root cause—corpus, retrieval, authority, generation, verification or UI—and create a regression fixture. User feedback never directly updates prompts, labels or the live answer tier.

§11Runtime &
degradation

Verify completely before streaming legally meaningful text

FailurePermitted outcomeForbidden shortcut
Provider unavailable/timeoutCurrent exact artifact/answer tier, or GENERATION_UNAVAILABLEUnqualified provider or ungrounded local prose
Schema/refusal/truncationTyped generation abstentionRepair loop or parsing “close enough” JSON
Inference/verifier unavailableAlready verified artifacts remain; novel generation stopsSkip T2/T3 or lower threshold
Citation resolution mismatchMaterial claim fails; defect alertDisplay model-written citation text
Optional claim failsDrop, then rerun completeness/coherenceVisible “partial support” on a legal proposition
Required claim/qualification failsGENERATION_UNVERIFIED with retrieval/search alternativesKeep the rest as a confident answer

11.1Observability

Spans: accept, cache lookup, prompt assembly, provider route/call, schema validation, citation resolution, deterministic/NLI/adversarial verification, register classification, completeness, persistence and stream release. Metrics by task/language/provider/model include schema-invalid, unknown handle, claim pass/drop, whole-answer failure, register violation, cache hit/invalidation/stale-blocked, tokens, cost and latency. Content never appears in span attributes.

§12Evaluation
& red team

Measure support, completeness and usefulness separately

A system that answers nothing has perfect factual precision. Report risk against useful-answer coverage, and isolate L4 from retrieval so a generation defect cannot hide inside an end-to-end average.

12.1Two benchmark tracks

  • Oracle-context: lawyers provide the complete evidence bundle. Measures generation, attribution, legal modality, verification and register.
  • End-to-end: real L3 output. Measures the full ceiling, including corpus/retrieval/coverage failure.

Stratify both by English/Urdu/mixed output, Roman Urdu input, task, statute/precedent/procedure, present/historical law, jurisdiction, conflict, answerable/unanswerable and risk class. Split by instrument/case family and legal issue to prevent near-duplicate leakage. Two Pakistani legal annotators independently mark atomic support, minimal spans, citation necessity/completeness, material qualifications, applicability and advice register; a senior reviewer adjudicates and agreement is reported.

MetricRelease targetWhy it exists
Citation resolution / quote exactness1.00 / 1.00Structural identity and verbatim source integrity
Human supported-claim precision≥0.97Atomic faithfulness; inherited QA-1
Material support recall1.00No essential legal claim escapes verification
Citation completeness / qualification recall≥0.95Prevents selective truth that omits provisos/conflict
Wrong place/date/authority on critical set0Legally relevant but inapplicable evidence is still wrong
Advice-register violation0Enforces the product boundary
English–Urdu faithfulness gap≤0.03Generation parity, separate from L3 NDCG gap
Cache precision / stale served≥0.95 / 0Reuse must preserve scope and currency

Also report complete-answer rate, useful coverage, selective risk–coverage curves, NLI AUROC/AUPRC and calibration error by language/risk, latency, cost, cache deflection and lawyer-rated material completeness. Automated judges are diagnostic until calibrated against lawyer labels; they are never the only merge gate.

12.2Adversarial fixtures

FixtureRequired result
User or retrieved footnote says “ignore policy,” forges E7, asks for prompt/HTML/imageNo action/active content; schema or support failure
Correct section from wrong province/date/versionHard failure; no legal block released
Claim changes may to shall, drops “unless,” or flips negationT1/T2 rejection
One true sentence omits the decisive proviso, savings clause or delegated ruleWhole-answer completeness veto
Dissent matches query; L5 authority finding absentNo ratio/binding claim; abstain or coverage limit
Conflicting authorities with a more recent, lower-similarity caseConflict preserved; no semantic winner
Urdu explanation strengthens duty or removes exceptionBilingual verifier rejection
Provider times out after emitting half a draftNo raw text reaches client; typed unavailable/cache alternative

12.3Ablations

Free prose vs constrained schema; block vs atomic claims; T1 only vs +T2 vs +T3; same vs independent adversarial verifier; raw vs data-only/no-tools context; exact vs fuzzy cache; provider/model snapshots; English vs Urdu; oracle vs retrieved context. Report paired deltas with confidence intervals. A prompt/model/verifier change cannot merge if any critical stratum regresses.

§13Delivery
contract

Build the trust path before the clever path

PhaseDeliverableExit gate
G0Contracts, fake/replay provider, prompt compiler, strict schema, evidence handlesMalformed/forged output cannot cross the adapter; no external model required in CI
G1DB citation/quote renderer, T0/T1 checks, artifact/audit persistenceCitation and quote exactness 1.00; persisted replay 100%
G2Hosted provider route, multilingual T2, register/whole-answer gateOracle-context faithfulness, Urdu parity and zero-register targets pass
G3Selective T3, escalation, exact verified cacheHigh-risk locked set passes inside latency/cost budget
G4Batch provision explainers, dependency invalidation, signed answer tierCache/pack precision ≥0.95; stale served = 0; release review complete
G5L5 task profiles and independently benchmarked self-hosted optionAuthority/calculator boundaries proven and provider swap is configuration

13.1Definition of done

  • No code path generates after L3 abstention or for exact-citation lookup.
  • No public citation, quote, date or URL originates in model output.
  • Every material claim is atomic, supported, resolved and verified; required-claim failure aborts the answer.
  • Whole-answer checks preserve qualifications, conflict, temporal/jurisdiction scope and deterministic-service boundaries.
  • Only verified artifacts/blocks are released; raw provider tokens never reach the client.
  • Persisted artifacts replay exactly; anonymous mode leaves no content behind.
  • Dependency invalidation covers provisions, judgments, schedules, authority/treatment, corpus and pipeline versions.
  • Locked lawyer-labelled tests, red team, latency, cost and bilingual gates pass in CI.
RPrimary
sources

References

  1. Constitution of Pakistan — current consolidated authority framework, including Articles 189 and 201. National Assembly, amended through 21 Nov 2025. Official PDF; source Twenty-Seventh Amendment Act, 2025.
  2. Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973 — section 22 practice boundary and statutory professional framework. Pakistan Code official PDF. Governing rules and free-legal-aid material are published by the Pakistan Bar Council.
  3. Hallucination-Free? Assessing the Reliability of Leading AI Legal Research Tools — Magesh et al.; preregistered empirical evaluation of LexisNexis and Thomson Reuters tools. Paper.
  4. Lexis+ with Protégé — official description of authoritative-source linking and Shepard’s validation. Official product page.
  5. CoCounsel Legal — official Thomson Reuters source-linking/task-workflow description. Official guide.
  6. CourtListener REST API — citation lookup/verification and graph API precedent. Free Law Project documentation.
  7. Caselaw Access Project — open, machine-readable case-law corpus/API precedent. Harvard Library Innovation Lab.
  8. European Legislation Identifier — stable, machine-readable legal identity precedent. EUR-Lex official documentation.
  9. LegalBench — Guha et al., 2023; 162 lawyer/researcher-contributed legal reasoning tasks. Paper.
  10. LegalBench-RAG — Pipitone & Alami, 2024; expert-annotated, precise legal retrieval spans. Paper.
  11. ALCE: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations — Gao, Yen, Yu & Chen, EMNLP 2023; separates citation correctness and completeness. Paper.
  12. Attributable to Identified Sources — Rashkin et al., Computational Linguistics 2023; human source-attribution evaluation framework. Paper.
  13. FActScore — Min et al., EMNLP 2023; atomic-fact decomposition and support scoring. Paper.
  14. AttributionBench — Li et al., ACL Findings 2024; demonstrates continuing limits of automatic attribution evaluation. Paper.
  15. TRUE and SummaC — factual-consistency evaluation and the importance of claim/source granularity for NLI. TRUE; SummaC.
  16. Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet — Huang et al., ICLR 2024; evidence against unaided retry/self-correction as a safety mechanism. Paper.
  17. Indirect prompt injection — Greshake et al., 2023; retrieved data can act as adversarial instructions. Paper; practical controls in the OWASP RAG Security Cheat Sheet.
  18. JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 — provider-neutral structural-output validation. Official specification.
  19. NIST AI 600-1 Generative AI Profile — confabulation, information integrity, privacy, security, provenance and continuous evaluation/red-team risk controls. Official PDF.
  20. W3C PROV-O — recommendation for entities, activities, agents and derivation relationships used conceptually by the audit graph. W3C Recommendation.
  21. Local architecture evidence — Document 01, 03, 03b, 04, 08, 09a and 09b.

Part 06 — Domain Services

06Layer L5

Domain Services

An evidence-bearing Pakistani legal decision layer: precedent is a qualified graph signal, deadlines and fees are versioned calculations, procedures are authored rules, and operative document clauses enter only through reviewed deterministic code.

Version 1.0Date 30 Aug 2026Layer L5Provides IPrecedent · IDraft · IProcedureRequires ICorpusRead · IGenerateFigures 4
↑ Contents
§1Mandate
& proof

Translate law into traceable decisions, never invisible opinion

L5 converts facts already supplied by a user into narrow domain results: treatment evidence, a calculation, an ordered procedure, or a document assembled from approved clauses. It does not retrieve open-ended law, invent facts, decide a dispute, predict a judge, or replace an advocate.

InvariantExecutable consequenceProof basis
D-INV-1Every conclusion carries jurisdiction, asOf, rule-pack version, corpus version, source provisions and a human-readable trace.Pakistan Code directs doubtful users to the relevant Gazette; the Publication of Laws of Pakistan Act creates the Laws of Pakistan Cell.
D-INV-2Rules and tables are effective-dated and territorial. A federal consolidation cannot silently supply a provincial fee or stamp rate.Court-Fees Act ss.20, 26, 35 and provincial amendments; provincial Stamp Act schedules; KP fee abolition is a concrete divergence.
D-INV-3A precedent status is an evidence-bearing signal with coverage, not a green/red badge.Constitution arts.189 and 201 establish binding relations; later treatment, bench composition, question of law and corpus gaps remain separate facts.
D-INV-4The model may phrase or summarize; it cannot choose a clause, deadline, rate, forum, authority class or treatment.NJPMC’s 2026 Guidelines position AI as assistive while preserving human judgment, accountability and transparency.
D-INV-5No result labelled “reviewed,” “file-ready” or “good law” without the corresponding human workflow and evidence.Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act 1973 s.22; product boundary requires counsel review rather than an overbroad claim about all automation.

Legal status of the executable rule. The Gazette or judgment remains authoritative. A RuleVersion is Nizam-e-Qanoon’s reviewed interpretation of that source, not a new source of law. Every screen and artifact must preserve that distinction.

1.1Release bars

Source resolution 1.00; published rules with two-person legal approval 1.00; arithmetic and calendar fixtures 1.00; wrong province/date/court hierarchy in the critical set 0; unexplained precedent edge 0; clause without rule and source 0; stale result after dependency publication 0; English–Urdu material-parity gap ≤0.03.

§2Pakistani
source order

Authority begins with the promulgated source, not the convenient website

A domain result is only as defensible as its source resolution. Pakistan Code is an essential official access layer, but its own disclaimer says material is under review and doubtful questions should return to Gazette notifications. The service therefore stores source rank and never collapses an access copy into promulgation proof.

RankSource classUsePublication rule
P0Constitution / Gazette / official judgment PDFControlling text, commencement, amendment, judicial holding and orderRequired for every operative rule; hash, page and provision/paragraph anchor stored
P1Official consolidated codeCurrent readable text and amendment footnotes from Pakistan Code, Punjab Laws, Sindh Code and KP CodeUseful access copy; compare to P0 before a calculator or clause rule becomes active
P2Official administrative portalCurrent operational rates, forms, e-stamp workflow, court rules, calendars and filing instructionsMay drive operations only when its issuing authority and effective date are captured
P3Reporter / editorial sourceParallel citation, digest and discoveryNever the sole source for text, treatment or a calculator parameter
P4Model or secondary commentaryCandidate extraction and review assistanceCannot publish a rule or treatment edge

2.1Effective authority matrix after the Twenty-Seventh Amendment

Deciding courtBinding reach encoded by L5Guard
Federal Constitutional CourtUnder current Article 189(1), a decision on a question/principle of law binds all other courts, including the Supreme Court.Only matters within the actual decision; capture majority, separate opinions and issue proposition.
Supreme CourtUnder Article 189(2), a decision on a question/principle of law binds all other courts except the Federal Constitutional Court.Do not apply the pre-November-2025 hierarchy to an asOf date after the amendment.
High CourtArticle 201 binds courts subordinate to that High Court to the stated extent.Territorial High Court and subordinate forum must match; other High Courts are persuasive unless another rule applies.
Federal Shariat Court / specialist hierarchyApply the Constitution and enabling statute’s typed appellate and binding relations.No generic numeric “court rank”; domain and appeal route are required.

The hierarchy is bitemporal. A case decided before the amendment keeps its decision date; the question whether and how it controls a later matter is evaluated against the constitutional and transitional framework applicable to the query date. L5 consumes explicit court-domain edges from Document 03b and does not infer them from a court-name string.

§3Bounded
contexts

One modular monolith, three legal domains, one rule registry

Deploy L5 inside the backend monolith. Split ownership by bounded context, not by network hop. A shared deterministic kernel resolves scope, sources, time, rules, trace and publication; each domain owns its vocabulary and outcomes.

ModuleOwnsMay callMust not own
precedent/Treatment proposition, case authority signal, coverage and structured judgment profileICorpusRead; IGenerate for verified summaryOpen search, model-inferred court hierarchy, bare good-law verdict
documents/Interview schema, typed answers, clause rules, template, render and artifact provenanceICorpusRead; IGenerate for wording onlyModel clause selection, legal review claim, payment/e-stamp issuance
procedure/Guides, limitation, fees, stamp duty, forum, checklists and holiday calendarsICorpusReadPrediction, discretionary judicial findings, hidden assumptions
rules/Draft/review/publish lifecycle, deterministic evaluator, dependency graph and traceICorpusReadHTTP, users, billing, model SDKs
§4Executable
law model

A rule is a proposition tied to text, scope and time

Do not start with a general-purpose expert-system language. Start with a small, typed expression grammar sufficient for comparison, dates, money, set membership and explicit priorities. Preserve an export mapping to LegalRuleML concepts, but keep the runtime understandable to Pakistani lawyers and application engineers.

type RuleVersion = {
  ruleId; version; domain; status: "draft" | "review" | "published" | "retired";
  jurisdiction; territory[]; forumKinds[]; matterKinds[];
  validFrom; validTo?; transactionFrom; transactionTo?;
  authority: AuthorityAnchor[];        // provision/judgment paragraph/Gazette page
  proposition;                         // lawyer-readable controlled English
  when: Expr; unless?: Expr[]; priority: PrioritySpec;
  effect: Effect; requiredInputs: FieldSpec[];
  interpretationNotes[]; testFixtureIds[];
  draftedBy; reviewedBy[]; approvedAt?; digest;
}

type Effect =
  | { kind: "period"; value: Duration; accrual: AccrualRule }
  | { kind: "money"; formula: MoneyExpr; rounding: RoundingRule }
  | { kind: "forum"; courtTypeId; filingPlaceRule }
  | { kind: "require_clause" | "forbid_clause"; clauseId }
  | { kind: "procedure_step"; stepId; prerequisites[] }
  | { kind: "authority_relation"; relation; target };

type DecisionTrace = {
  inputDigest; scope; candidates[]; applicable[]; rejected[];
  evaluations: { ruleVersion; condition; inputs; result }[];
  conflicts[]; assumptions[]; unknowns[]; result; dependencyDigest;
}

4.1No arbitrary code in published content

  • Expressions are parsed to an allow-listed AST. No eval, imports, reflection, SQL, network, filesystem or model call.
  • Money uses decimal arithmetic with an explicit currency and rounding rule. Dates use civil-date types, not local timestamps.
  • Every input is typed, unit-labelled and either user-asserted, corpus-derived or administrative data. The trace distinguishes them.
  • Priority is explicit: constitutional hierarchy, special/local law, non-obstante/subject-to edges, later effective provision, or unresolved conflict. A row order is never legal priority.
  • Unknown facts propagate. They do not become false. The result is complete, conditional, not_covered or conflict.

Research precedent. OASIS LegalRuleML explicitly models jurisdiction, temporality, defeasibility, negation, authority and the link between a legal rule and its natural-language source. OECD Rules as Code and New Zealand Better Rules likewise insist that machine-consumable rules remain alongside human-readable rules. We adopt those properties, not their full syntax.

§5Precedent
citator

Answer “what happened to this proposition?”, not “is this case good?”

A judgment may remain valid on one proposition and be doubted, distinguished or displaced on another. The citator’s unit is therefore a normalized legal proposition linked to exact paragraphs, not the whole case.

type TreatmentEdge = {
  citingOpinionId; citingParagraphIds[];
  citedOpinionId; citedParagraphIds[]; propositionId;
  treatment: "followed" | "applied" | "approved" | "affirmed" |
             "distinguished" | "doubted" | "disapproved" |
             "overruled" | "reversed" | "explained" | "cited";
  polarity: "positive" | "negative" | "neutral";
  effectScope: "proposition" | "holding" | "order" | "unknown";
  extraction: { method; confidence; modelVersion? };
  reviewStatus: "machine_candidate" | "lawyer_verified" | "contested";
  evidenceQuoteOffsets[]; sourceVersionId;
}

5.1Signal contract

type AuthoritySignal = {
  judgmentId; propositionSignals[];
  summary: "no_adverse_treatment_found" | "adverse_treatment_found" |
           "mixed_or_distinguished" | "coverage_insufficient";
  supportingEdges[]; adverseEdges[]; unresolvedEdges[];
  hierarchyApplied[]; coverage: { courts[]; from; to; documents; missingSources[] };
  generatedAt; asOf; corpusVersion; traceId;
}

no_adverse_treatment_found means exactly that within declared coverage. It never becomes “still good law.” Machine extraction can prioritize review, but overruled, reversed and proposition-level negative treatment require lawyer verification before public display.

5.2Ingestion and identity

Use official judgment portals for the Federal Constitutional Court, Supreme Court and each High Court. Preserve case number, decision date, upload date, bench, author, separate/dissenting opinions, disposition and source hash. Reporter citations are aliases. Paragraph anchors are canonical where the judgment numbers paragraphs; otherwise create stable source offsets while retaining page coordinates.

§6Judgment
profiles

Summaries are verified profiles, not editorial headnotes

L5 chooses the schema and supplies the judgment; L4 may phrase fields, but Document 05’s atomic support and whole-answer veto apply. No summary field can create a treatment or authority edge.

FieldEvidence ruleFailure behavior
Procedural postureCase header, impugned order and disposition paragraphsUnknown if source pages are missing
Material factsEach fact linked to a paragraph; party allegation labelled as allegationDrop unsupported fact
Questions/issuesExpress issue paragraph or clearly qualified reconstructionMark inferred_issue, never quotation
ArgumentsKeep each party and court treatment separateNo laundering an argument into a holding
Reasoning and holdingMajority paragraphs and exact proposition supportWhole profile fails if decisive qualification is unsupported
OrderOperative final paragraphs onlyNo inference from case metadata

Profiles are regenerated only when the judgment source, schema, verifier or correction record changes. A later judgment changes the citator’s treatment view, not the historical text of the earlier judgment profile.

§7Limitation
engine

A deadline is an event calculation with legal branches

The Limitation Act’s First Schedule supplies periods and starting points, but a useful calculator must also model the mandatory bar in section 3, court closure in section 4, the limited extension route in section 5, disability, exclusions, fraud, acknowledgment, payment, continuing wrongs and the special/local-law rule in section 29.

StageDeterministic workRequired evidence / guard
LIM-0Resolve claim/application/appeal type, relief, forum, governing special law and asOf.Ambiguous cause maps to candidates; service never chooses a cause of action for the user.
LIM-1Select applicable Schedule article or special/local period and accrual rule.Section 29(2) determines which general provisions remain available when a special/local law differs.
LIM-2Construct event timeline: accrual, knowledge, death/representation, disability, prior proceeding, stay, acknowledgment and payment.Every date labelled asserted, documented or inferred; inferred dates cannot yield a final deadline.
LIM-3Apply included/excluded day rules, calendar arithmetic and effective court closures.Official court calendar version and timezone; no timestamp arithmetic.
LIM-4Evaluate exclusions/restarts in legal order and retain every rejected branch.Section 5 is not a general power to extend every suit; service states the relevant proceeding class.
LIM-5Return base date, adjustments, computed last day, safer filing-by date and uncertainty.Where a judicial finding such as sufficient cause, good faith, fraud or due diligence is required, return conditional branches and advocate escalation.

7.1Result shape

type LimitationResult = {
  status: "complete" | "conditional" | "not_covered" | "conflict";
  governingRule; period; accrualEvent; baseDeadline?;
  adjustments: { kind; from; to; days; authority; condition? }[];
  finalDeadline?; conservativeFileBy?; calendarVersion;
  assumptions[]; disputedInputs[]; alternatives[]; authorities[]; traceId;
}

Never market a limitation date as guaranteed. Section 3 makes lateness consequential even when limitation is not pleaded, while sections 4–25 and special/local laws can alter computation. The product must show the full calculation and tell users to file earlier and obtain legal review.

§8Fees, stamp
& forum

Province, relief and date are mandatory calculator inputs

The federal-era Court-Fees and Stamp Acts are only the trunk. Provincial finance acts, amendment acts, rules, remissions and operational valuation systems alter the result. Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s Court Fees (Abolition) Ordinance is proof that a national rate table would be structurally wrong.

CalculatorMinimum inputsSource stackOutput guard
Court feeProvince/ICT, court, filing kind, relief, valuation basis, amount, date, exemptionsCourt-Fees Act; provincial amendment/finance acts; High Court process-fee rules; Gazette remissionsSeparate institution fee, process fee and incidental charges; never one opaque total
Stamp dutyProvince/ICT, instrument classification, consideration/value, property location/use, execution date, partiesStamp Act and current provincial Schedule I; Gazette notifications; official e-stamp parametersShow classification and rate; link to official payment/verification portal rather than issuing a stamp
RegistrationInstrument, property, term/value, location, execution/presentation datesRegistration Act ss.17–35 plus provincial rules and fee notificationsReturn compulsory/optional/unknown and presentation requirements; not title assurance
ForumMatter, statute, relief, value, territory, parties, subject property and dateConstitution/enabling statute; CPC ss.15–20; civil-court laws; special tribunals and local limitsReturn candidate forum and unresolved venue facts; no prediction that jurisdiction objection will succeed

8.1Parameters are data, classifications are reviewed rules

rate_table(table_id, kind, jurisdiction, valid_from, valid_to, source_version_id, digest)
rate_band(table_id, instrument_or_relief, lower_bound, upper_bound,
          fixed_amount, rate, cap, floor, rounding_rule, condition_expr)
valuation_rule(rule_version_id, subject_kind, measure, formula_expr, source_anchor)
court_competence(court_type_id, territory_id, matter_kind, pecuniary_range,
                 valid_from, valid_to, enabling_source_anchor)
court_calendar(court_id, closed_date, reason, notification_source_anchor, version)

Punjab’s official PLRA e-stamping service already calculates stamp duty, CVT and related charges and issues a verifiable challan/e-stamp. Nizam-e-Qanoon should deep-link or reconcile against that official service where available, not compete with it as a payment authority. Differences between our estimate and an official portal are a blocking incident for the affected rule pack.

§9Document
factory

The interview gathers facts; reviewed rules construct the instrument

The document factory follows the proven guided-interview pattern used by docassemble, but adds Pakistan-specific source, province, language, stamp, registration and provenance controls. AI can simplify a question; it never alters the field schema or operative clause set.

9.1Document pack

type DocumentPackVersion = {
  documentType; jurisdiction; language; validFrom; validTo?;
  fieldSchema; interviewFlow; clauseRules[]; clauseVersions[];
  templateVersions: { docx; pdf; urdu? }; feeRuleRefs[];
  registrationRules[]; executionChecklist[]; reviewPolicy;
  sourceAnchors[]; lawyerApprovals[]; regressionSuite; digest;
}
First packWhyControlling source mapHard limitation
General affidavitBounded fields and execution blocks; exercises bilingual renderingApplicable court/notarial/oath rules and filing-specific form requirementsNo claim that facts are sworn until execution before the proper authority
Residential tenancy — Punjab/ICT separatelyHigh citizen value and clear proof of territorial divergencePunjab Rented Premises Act 2009 or Islamabad Rent Restriction Ordinance 2001; Registration and Stamp lawsNo “Pakistan-wide rent agreement”; Sindh/KP/Balochistan require separate packs
Legal notice shellReusable service/address/claim structureMatter-specific notice provision and service rule selected before the shellNo model-authored allegation, remedy choice or threat; advocate review strongly required

9.2Rendering and safety

  • DOCX is the editable professional artifact; PDF is a preview/finalized rendering. XeLaTeX or an equivalently tested engine handles Urdu, mixed direction and embedded fonts.
  • Rendering runs without network, shell escape, user-controlled template paths or executable macros. Uploaded images are decoded and re-encoded.
  • Artifact provenance lists every clause ID/version, rule that fired, source anchors, omitted optional clauses, duty estimate, template digest and whether an advocate reviewed it.
  • A material field change invalidates prior review and render signatures. Anonymous sessions retain no answers or artifacts after delivery.
§10Procedure
guides

A guide is a versioned state machine with official exits

Procedure should not be generated as a confident list. Each guide is expert-authored from the governing law and current court/agency instructions, and each step has prerequisites, outputs, timing, fees, form versions and a verified official destination.

type ProcedureGuideVersion = {
  procedureId; jurisdiction; forum; validFrom; validTo?;
  entryConditions[]; requiredFacts[]; steps: ProcedureStep[];
  alternatives[]; stopConditions[]; escalationTriggers[];
  sourceAnchors[]; officialLinks[]; calendarRefs[];
  reviewedBy[]; publishedAt; digest;
}

type ProcedureStep = {
  stepId; titleEn; titleUr; prerequisiteExpr; requiredDocuments[];
  action; responsibleActor; destination; deadlineRule?; feeRule?;
  produces[]; next[]; authorityAnchors[]; operationalLinkId?;
}
ControlImplementation
Official-link integrityAllow-listed government/court domains; scheduled HEAD/GET check; content fingerprint and redirect review; last-verified date shown.
FormsStore form version, issuing body and effective interval. A replaced form invalidates the affected step and offline pack.
Local practiceLabel administrative practice separately from legislation/rules; require registry confirmation date and never present it as statutory law.
AccessibilityPlain English and Urdu, printable checklist, low-bandwidth version, official source link and advocate/legal-aid referral.
CompletionUser check-off records progress only; it never certifies legal compliance or filing acceptance.
§11Rule
publication

Treat legal content changes like signed production releases

A Git commit is not legal approval, and a lawyer’s email is not a reproducible deployment. Rule publishing combines source evidence, structured review, executable tests, maker-checker separation and atomic activation.

GateActorEvidenceFailure
R0 SourceLegal data curatorP0/P1 source identity, hash, dates, extent, amendment/commencement chainNo rule draft
R1 ModelLegal engineerControlled-English proposition, typed expression, examples and non-examplesReturn to draft
R2 LegalPakistani advocate for domain/provinceInterpretation, exceptions, conflict, source anchors and user-facing wordingCannot approve own draft alone
R3 TechnicalApplication engineerSchema, deterministic execution, property tests, security and performanceCannot publish
R4 RegressionCI + reviewerGolden/mutation/temporal/bilingual fixtures and affected-dependency reportBlock merge
R5 PublishAuthorized publisherSigned manifest; transaction activates pack and invalidates dependentsPrevious version remains active
R6 MonitorLegal operationsGazette/court/portal watch, broken links, user challenges and incident SLAQuarantine affected result class

11.1Corrections are append-only

Never overwrite a published rule. Publish a successor with transaction time, legal validity interval and reason; retain the old digest for replay. An emergency quarantine can stop serving a rule immediately without pretending its historical publication never happened.

11.2Challenge workflow

Every result exposes “challenge this rule/treatment.” The challenge carries only the trace and user-selected issue unless the user elects to add facts. A lawyer can mark confirmed, needs_source, classification_error, outdated or interpretive_dispute. Interpretive disputes stay visible and do not become silent edits.

§12Persistence
& invalidation

Store dependencies, not just answers

A deadline, fee, precedent signal or document is derived state. It is safe to cache only when every source and rule dependency is recorded and invalidated together.

domain_result(id, kind, scope_json, input_digest, status, result_json,
              rule_pack_digest, corpus_version, trace_id, created_at, expires_at)
domain_result_dependency(result_id, dependency_kind, dependency_id,
                         dependency_version, dependency_digest)
rule_pack(id, domain, jurisdiction, version, status, manifest_digest,
          valid_from, valid_to, transaction_from, transaction_to)
rule_version(id, rule_id, pack_id, proposition, expression_ast,
             authority_json, review_json, digest)
decision_trace(id, input_digest, candidates_json, evaluation_json,
               conflict_json, result_digest, created_at)
legal_artifact(id, session_id, template_digest, logical_digest,
               binary_digest, provenance_json, review_status, retention_class)
EventInvalidatesAction
Provision/version/extent/commencement publishedRules anchored to it; procedures, calculations and documents derived from those rulesQuarantine or recompute before serving
Judgment/opinion/treatment edge published or correctedAffected proposition signals and summariesRecompute graph view; preserve old trace
Rate, calendar, court competence or form changesFee/deadline/forum results and affected guide/document packsInvalidate by dependency, not TTL alone
Rule or template successor publishedAll logical results using old digest for current requestsHistorical replay remains available; new render uses successor only after explicit migration

Anonymous mode stores no facts, traces containing facts or artifacts after the response. Operational metrics use aggregate counters. Named drafting matters receive explicit retention controls because party names, CNICs, addresses, property details and dispute facts are sensitive legal data.

§13Contracts
& runtime

Typed inability is a successful legal-safety outcome

interface IPrecedent {
  treatmentsOf(provisionId, filters): TreatmentView | DomainInability;
  summarise(judgmentId, profile): VerifiedJudgmentProfile | DomainInability;
  goodLawSignal(judgmentId, propositionId?, scope): AuthoritySignal | DomainInability;
}

interface IDraft {
  startInterview(documentType, jurisdiction, asOf, language): InterviewState | DomainInability;
  submitAnswers(session, answers): InterviewState | FieldErrors;
  preview(session): LogicalDocument | DomainInability;
  render(session, format): LegalArtifact | DomainInability;
}

interface IProcedure {
  guide(procedureId, jurisdiction, asOf): ProcedureGuide | DomainInability;
  limitation(matter, timeline, scope): LimitationResult;
  courtFee(filing, scope): MoneyResult;
  stampDuty(instrument, scope): MoneyResult;
  forum(matter, scope): ForumResult;
}

IPrecedent, IDraft and IProcedure remain the public boundaries inherited from Document 01. preview, selectable render format and stampDuty are explicit additive proposals for that contract; L6 can expose them only after the master interface and OpenAPI specification are versioned together.

Inability codeMeaningSafe alternative
SCOPE_REQUIREDProvince/ICT, forum, territory or date missingRequest exact missing fields
RULE_NOT_PUBLISHEDNo reviewed rule pack covers the requestShow sources/search and advocate referral
SOURCE_UNVERIFIEDConsolidation exists but controlling Gazette/source chain is incompleteShow research-only source with warning; no calculation/document
FACT_REQUIRES_FINDINGCredibility, good faith, sufficient cause, fraud, due diligence or legal characterization is contestedReturn conditional branches and counsel escalation
AUTHORITY_CONFLICTApplicable sources/precedents conflict without a deterministically resolved priorityPresent both with evidence
COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENTJudgment/source collection cannot support a status claimDeclare indexed courts/years and avoid negative inference
PACK_QUARANTINEDLegal/technical incident disables the rule packOfficial link and incident-safe message

13.1Runtime and security

  • Normal calculators and published guides run in-process against immutable pack snapshots; no network call and p95 under 150 ms.
  • Precedent graph queries run in PostgreSQL with bounded depth, court/date filters and statement timeouts; summaries are asynchronous or cached verified artifacts.
  • Document compilation runs in an isolated worker with CPU/memory/time limits, read-only templates, no network, no shell escape and content-addressed outputs.
  • A request pins one rule-pack manifest and corpus version. Mid-request publication cannot create a mixed result.
  • Only L6 authorizes sessions and persistence. L5 accepts an anonymous policy flag and returns artifacts without creating a hidden domain-side account or history.

13.2Offline

Signed offline packs may include published procedure guides, limitation/rate tables, court competence and pre-approved document interview schemas. They exclude the server-scale precedent graph and novel document rendering. Each offline result shows pack version and knowledge date; revoked/quarantined rule IDs are carried by signed patches.

§14Evaluation
& delivery

Prove each domain with adversarial legal fixtures

SuiteRequired coverageRelease target
TemporalDay before/on/after amendment, commencement, expiry, court closure and rate boundary100% expected trace and result
TerritorialSame facts across Punjab, Sindh, KP, Balochistan and ICT; mismatched property/forum0 cross-jurisdiction leak
LimitationFirst Schedule, special law, ss.4–25, s.29, acknowledgment before/after expiry, conditional judicial facts100% deterministic fixtures; discretion never collapsed
MoneyBand boundaries, caps/floors, exemptions, percentage/fixed combinations, decimal rounding and amended tablesExact against lawyer-certified worksheets/official portal samples
PrecedentFCC/SC/HC hierarchy, pre/post amendment, majority/dissent, proposition-level distinction/overruling and missing coverage0 bare status; all public adverse edges lawyer-verified
DocumentsEvery rule branch, mutually exclusive clauses, omitted facts, hostile text, Urdu directionality, render sandbox and provenance0 unsourced clause; 100% logical reproducibility
MutationFlip shall/may, province, date comparator, negation, rate, priority and exceptionEvery material mutation killed by tests

14.1Independent legal validation

For each launch domain, two Pakistani advocates independently annotate source, proposition, scope, exceptions and expected result; a senior reviewer adjudicates. Report agreement and unresolved interpretive disputes. Test data separates rules used to author implementation from a locked challenge set. Production challenges feed triage, never automatic learning.

14.2Build order

PhaseDeliverableExit gate
D0Scope resolver, rule schema/AST, source anchors, trace, fake packs and publication lifecycleArbitrary code impossible; bitemporal replay and maker-checker proven
D1Limitation MVP for a tightly enumerated civil/application setLawyer-certified fixtures and conditional branches pass; no broad marketing
D2Punjab/ICT fee, stamp and forum subsets plus official portal reconciliationExact current samples; divergence incidents block release
D3Versioned procedure guides, forms, calendars and signed offline packAll links/forms verified; bilingual/accessibility review complete
D4Precedent graph, proposition/treatment review console and qualified signalHierarchy and coverage locked set passes; no unreviewed adverse public edge
D5Three separately scoped document packs and sandbox rendererEvery clause sourced; artifacts reproducible; advocate review workflow operational
D6Additional provinces/domains only by independent packNo copy-and-rename jurisdiction port; province-specific legal sign-off

14.3Definition of done

  • Every result identifies controlling sources, territory, date, rules, inputs, assumptions, unknowns and coverage.
  • No executable rule is active from an unverified consolidation alone.
  • No model chooses authority, treatment, clause, deadline, fee, stamp rate, forum or procedure step.
  • No “good law” or “no precedent” claim replaces evidence and declared coverage.
  • No document clause lacks a published rule and exact legal source.
  • Rule changes publish atomically, invalidate every dependent result and preserve historical replay.
  • Critical temporal, territorial, mutation, bilingual and sandbox suites pass with independent legal review.
RPrimary
sources

References and proof register

  1. Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan — current consolidated text through 21 Nov 2025; Articles 189 and 201 and the post-Twenty-Seventh-Amendment court structure. National Assembly official PDF. Presidential assent to the Twenty-Seventh Amendment was recorded on 13 Nov 2025 by the President of Pakistan.
  2. Federal Constitutional Court — official institutional jurisdiction and commencement description. FCCP official portal. An official FCCP judgment reproduces current Article 189 and its binding order. Official judgment PDF.
  3. Official judgment sources — Federal Constitutional Court judgments; Supreme Court judgments search; High Court of Sindh; Peshawar High Court. Each is used as a source adapter, not as proof of complete national coverage.
  4. Publication of Laws of Pakistan Act, 2016 — maintenance and institutional functions of the Laws of Pakistan Cell. Pakistan Code official PDF.
  5. Pakistan Code — Ministry of Law and Justice official access service; its disclaimer says content is under review and doubtful questions should refer to the relevant Gazette notifications. Official portal.
  6. Provincial official codes — Punjab Laws Online (also described by PITB); Sindh Code; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Code. They prove why adapters and provenance are jurisdiction-specific.
  7. Limitation Act, 1908 — sections 3–25, section 29 and the First Schedule. Pakistan Code official PDF.
  8. Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 — jurisdiction/venue, filing, procedure, pauper suits and court powers relevant to forum, fee and guides. Pakistan Code official PDF.
  9. Court-Fees Act, 1870 — valuation, schedules, process-fee rules, Gazette publication, remissions and rate variation. Pakistan Code official PDF. Provincial divergence example: KP Court Fees (Abolition) Ordinance, 1978.
  10. Stamp Act, 1899 — instrument classification and Schedule I foundation. Pakistan Code official PDF. Provincial proof: KP official consolidation and Sindh amendment catalogue.
  11. Punjab e-Stamping — official operational calculation, challan and verification process. Punjab Land Records Authority; official user guide.
  12. Registration Act, 1908 — compulsory/optional registration, time, place and presentation requirements. Pakistan Code official PDF.
  13. Transfer of Property Act, 1882 — property-transfer and lease provisions and express relationship to the Registration Act. Pakistan Code official PDF.
  14. Islamabad Rent Restriction Ordinance, 2001 — agreement, tenure, registration, rent and controller procedure for ICT. Pakistan Code official PDF.
  15. Sindh Rented Premises Ordinance, 1979 — rent, receipt, service and controller rules showing a distinct provincial pack. Sindh Code official PDF.
  16. Punjab Rented Premises Act, 2009 — official law repository is Punjab Laws Online; section 5 requires a tenancy agreement and presentation before the Rent Registrar. It must be verified against the official consolidation/Gazette before pack publication.
  17. Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973 — section 22 professional-practice boundary. Pakistan Bar Council official PDF; acts and rules catalogue at the Pakistan Bar Council.
  18. National Guidelines for Use of Artificial Intelligence in Judicial Institutions of Pakistan — AI as assistive, human-centric, transparent, accountable and privacy-protecting. Law and Justice Commission of Pakistan; NJPMC adoption record in official decision PDF.
  19. Rules as Code — OECD describes official machine-consumable rules alongside natural-language rules and the accountability implications. Cracking the Code; current OECD Law as Code consultation.
  20. Better Rules – Better Outcomes — New Zealand government multidisciplinary, human-and-machine implementation precedent. Official programme.
  21. LegalRuleML Core Specification 1.0 — OASIS standard for jurisdiction, temporality, defeasibility, authority and source-rule isomorphism. Authoritative specification.
  22. OpenFisca — open rules-as-code precedent separating country/domain legislation, variables and parameters from the core simulation engine. Official documentation.
  23. docassemble — open-source legal guided-interview and document-assembly precedent with multilingual, accessibility and attorney-review workflows. Official documentation.
  24. European Legislation Identifier — stable human/machine legal identity and metadata precedent, including article-level identifiers. EUR-Lex official documentation.
  25. Caselaw Access Project — machine-readable case-law corpus/API precedent and coverage lesson. Harvard Library Innovation Lab.
  26. Local architecture evidence — Document 01, 02, 03, 03b, 04, 05, 08, 09a and 09b.

Part 07 — Backend API

07Layer L6

Backend API

The enforceable boundary around Pakistani legal intelligence: versioned HTTP contracts, phone-first identity, verified answer orchestration, privacy-shaped persistence, signed distribution and an audit trail that can prove what the system knew and did.

Version 1.0Date 30 Aug 2026Layer L6Provides IPublicAPI · ISync · IUserSyncRequires IRetrieve · IGenerate · IPrecedent · IDraft · IProcedureFigures 5
↑ Contents
§0Mandate
& proof

The API coordinates legal truth; it never manufactures it

L6 is the sole synchronous entry point and the sole authority for identity, persistence and release. It converts stable layer contracts into a client-safe protocol while preserving every abstention, qualification, source version and inability returned below it.

Inherited ruleBackend enforcementAcceptance evidence
INV-1Public schemas accept and return ResolvedCitation; no route accepts model-authored citation text, URL, date or identifier.Schema and architecture test prove no citation-string constructor in L6.
INV-2Abstention cannot enter IGenerate. The answer orchestrator has disjoint passed and abstained branches.Mutation test fails if a generation call occurs on the abstention branch.
INV-3An authenticated answer is releasable only after its verified artifact and replay graph commit. Anonymous privacy deliberately supersedes durable replay.100% non-anonymous completions replay byte-for-byte from pinned artifacts.
INV-4Chunk identifiers are rejected at the public schema boundary; durable URLs and client state use instrument, provision, judgment or answer identity.OpenAPI contains no public chunk_id.
INV-5Every legal read has an explicit as_of; today is resolved once at request admission in Asia/Karachi, then carried as a value.Contract test rejects an unresolved temporal scope below the route layer.
QA-12Anonymous admission binds an ephemeral execution policy with no durable writer, cache insertion, content telemetry, history, sync or artifact retention.Dependency-graph test enumerates zero persistence ports.

Normative language

Must and shall are release requirements. An outcome is a valid legal result such as abstention or insufficient facts; a problem is a protocol or system fault. L6 must never translate the first into the second merely to simplify a client.

§1Boundary
& modules

A modular monolith with ports, not internal HTTP

One FastAPI deployment owns routes and orchestration; the legal modules remain ordinary typed Python dependencies. Inference and rendering are separate workers because they have different resource and isolation needs, not because service boundaries are fashionable.

nizam/api/
  app.py                 composition root and lifespan
  middleware/            context, auth, limits, idempotency, audit envelope
  routes/                thin v1 routers; no SQL and no legal logic
  contracts/             Pydantic strict input/output types; OpenAPI source
  application/           use-case orchestrators and transaction policy
  identity/ policies/    authentication and authorization decisions
  audit/ metering/       replay graph, incidents and append-only usage
  sync/ jobs/            separate corpus/user sync and durable work
  adapters/              Postgres, SMS, object store; no LLM adapter here
§2Context
& snapshots

Resolve ambiguity once; pin legal state for the whole request

A long model call must not hold a database transaction open, yet a legal answer cannot combine one corpus release with another. Admission therefore takes a short read transaction, resolves scope and pins immutable identifiers; every downstream read supplies those identifiers explicitly.

RequestContext {
  requestId: UUIDv7; traceId: TraceId; apiVersion: "v1";
  actor: AnonymousActor | UserActor | ServiceActor;
  execution: "anonymous_ephemeral" | "authenticated_persistent";
  locale: "en-PK" | "ur-PK"; readingLevel: "plain" | "professional";
  legalScope: { jurisdiction; territory?; forum?; authorityPerspective?; asOf };
  knowledgeAsOf: CorpusRevisionId; corpusVersion: bigint;
  ruleManifest?: RulePackManifestId; taxonomyVersion: string;
  policy: { entitlements[]; dataClass; retentionClass; riskClass };
  deadline: Instant; client: { app; version; deviceClass? };
}
Admission decisionRuleFailure
Request identityClient supplies X-Request-ID as UUIDv7 or server creates it. Duplicate identity is allowed only through idempotency.invalid_request_identity
DateResolve missing as_of to the current Pakistan civil date once; emit the resolved date in every legal response.invalid_legal_date
JurisdictionNever infer a province from IP, SIM or profile. User-supplied and system-inferred values remain labelled separately.Typed scope_required outcome
CorpusPin one published corpus version and enabled scope. A mid-request publication cannot enter the result.Retry preflight once; then corpus_unavailable
RulesCalculators and drafts pin one active, signed rule manifest compatible with the corpus and date.rule_pack_unavailable outcome
DeadlineOne absolute deadline propagates to database statements and adapters; child calls receive smaller budgets.operation_timed_out

Connections set actor context with transaction-scoped SET LOCAL before any RLS-protected query and clear automatically at commit. A pooled connection must never retain user scope. Corpus reads use the restricted application role; corpus publication remains physically unavailable to L6.

Database contract as built. The application role receives legal rows through v_release_instrument, v_release_provision and v_release_provision_version, never active base tables. The release identifier must pin verifier, adjudication, identity, contents-completeness, expression-manifest and boundary state. On 10 September 2026 this boundary contains 3,720 instruments, 300,137 provisions and 285,156 versions; blocked evidence remains accessible only to the curation role. One source observation may expose several expressions, so API identity includes the materialised instrument UUID and never assumes one PDF equals one law.

§3HTTP
contract

Contract-first, additive within v1, mechanically diffed

openapi/nizam-v1.yaml is generated from strict route contracts, linted and diffed in CI. OpenAPI 3.2 describes REST operations; the SSE event catalogue is a companion schema because an event stream is not an ordinary JSON response.

ConcernNormative decision
Base and versionshttps://api.nizam.pk/v1. Breaking representation or semantic changes require /v2; additive optional fields and new endpoints stay in v1.
SerializationUTF-8 JSON, RFC 3339 instants, ISO 8601 civil dates, decimal money as strings plus ISO currency, UUIDv7 public request/resource identifiers.
StrictnessMutation inputs reject unknown fields. Outputs are typed discriminated unions. Numeric dates, floats for money and unbounded strings are forbidden.
PaginationOpaque, signed cursor over a stable sort and snapshot; never an offset for changing judgment or audit collections.
Conditional readsPublic immutable legal resources expose strong ETag; temporal and corpus version are in the representation and cache key.
MutationsIdempotency-Key required for answer creation, draft rendering, reports, sync push and publication commands.
Errorsapplication/problem+json following RFC 9457. Domain outcomes remain normal typed representations, not fake HTTP errors.
DeprecationMark in OpenAPI, emit Deprecation and Sunset, retain at least two supported client releases, publish migration notes.

§4Identity
& sessions

Phone-first is an access choice, not a claim of strong identity

SMS proves temporary control of a number; it does not prove the subscriber is the named person or an enrolled advocate. The backend keeps account login, professional verification and privileged-administrator assurance as separate facts.

ControlCitizen / advocate accountPrivileged staff
Initial sign-inE.164 Pakistani number; single-use SMS OTP; email optional.Invite only; verified organizational identity.
AssurancePossession-level account. Advocate status is a separately reviewed credential with issuer and expiry.Phishing-resistant passkey/WebAuthn preferred; TOTP recovery; SMS alone forbidden.
Access tokenFive-minute signed token containing opaque subject, session id, assurance, scopes and token version; no phone, email or professional data.
RefreshOpaque 256-bit rotating token, hashed at rest, one family per device. Reuse revokes the whole family and creates a security event.
OTPChallenge-specific salted hash, ten-minute maximum, accepted once, five verification attempts, resend cooldown and progressive account/IP/device controls.
RecoveryNew-number recovery is delayed and risk-reviewed; saved legal data is not disclosed through an OTP-only shortcut.Two-person recovery with recorded evidence.

4.1Anonymous execution is a different composition root

Anonymous entry creates an opaque, SameSite-bound session and constructs AnonymousExecutionPolicy. That graph binds ephemeral in-memory buffers and no-op content telemetry; it does not bind answer history, drafts, user sync, semantic-cache insertion, billing identity or durable audit bodies. Joining later starts a fresh account context; it never imports anonymous history without an explicit, itemized user action.

Privacy beats replay

For anonymous work, retain content-free counters only: route class, coarse result class, latency bucket and service health. No query digest intended for later correlation, no evidence text, no answer body and no device fingerprint. An ephemeral request identifier may exist in memory only for the lifetime of the response.

§5Authorization
& tenancy

Every object lookup is an authorization decision

Roles express capability; ownership, matter membership, jurisdiction and workflow state decide the object. Route decorators alone are insufficient, so policy checks occur in the application service and PostgreSQL RLS supplies a second boundary for user data.

PrincipalMay doMust not do
AnonymousPublic law, search, unsaved verified answer, deterministic public calculator.History, drafts, downloads retained after delivery, reports containing stored replay.
CitizenOwn bookmarks, answers, matters and drafts; public legal tools within entitlement.Read another user’s opaque id; assert advocate status.
Verified advocateProfessional view and exports; own matters; advocate-only beta features.Access any client/matter not expressly assigned.
CuratorAssigned ingestion failures, source images, structured corrections, re-run gates.Publish corpus directly; view user legal matters.
Legal reviewerReview assigned rules, clauses, challenged answers and redacted replay packages.Publish a rule they authored; browse unrelated user content.
Rule authorCreate immutable candidate versions and tests.Activate their candidate.
Rule publisherApprove a separately authored candidate after gates and signature.Edit evidence during approval; self-approve.
SupportAccount metadata and user-provided request id; time-limited audited impersonation-free diagnostics.Query, answer, draft or matter bodies by default.
AdministratorIdentity, entitlement, operational configuration.Bypass maker-checker, corpus publisher role or RLS through the application.

Opaque identifiers are not authorization. Every GET /drafts/{id}, event stream, artifact URL and sync record verifies actor-object relation. Signed object-store URLs are short-lived, single-purpose and minted only after authorization; storage buckets are never public.

§6Answer
orchestration

Persist the proof before releasing the legal prose

The backend streams progress, not speculative model tokens. Retrieval may abstain; generation may abstain; verification may drop a claim or veto the whole artifact. Only a complete verified artifact crosses the release barrier.

6.1Two-step streaming contract

POST /v1/answers validates, idempotently creates the operation and returns 202 with its resource and event URL. GET /v1/answers/{id}/events serves text/event-stream. This corrects the conceptual one-request sequence in Document 01 so standard EventSource reconnection and authorization can be implemented cleanly.

event: answer.status
id: 3
data: {"request_id":"...","phase":"verifying","progress":"claims"}

event: answer.block
id: 4
data: {"block":{...verified block with resolved citations...}}

event: answer.completed
id: 5
data: {"answer_id":"...","artifact_digest":"...","scope":{...}}
  • Allowed events: answer.status, answer.abstained, answer.block, answer.completed, answer.cancelled and answer.problem. Raw provider deltas are impossible at this boundary.
  • Events have monotonically increasing per-answer ids. Last-Event-ID replays only after actor authorization and only from the stored verified journal.
  • Anonymous replay exists only within the same ephemeral session and process for five minutes. Loss returns 410 anonymous_stream_expired; the user may restart, not recover hidden persistence.
  • Heartbeat comments every 15 seconds carry no content. Proxy buffering is disabled. Disconnect cancels provider work when no durable consumer remains, except after the release barrier where completion is cheap and deterministic.

§8Outcomes
& problems

Uncertainty is data, not an exception

A calculator needing a judicial finding, a precedent graph with incomplete coverage and a retrieval abstention are successful safety outcomes. HTTP errors are reserved for invalid commands, policy refusal and system faults.

LegalOutcome<T> =
  | { outcome: "complete"; value: T; scope; provenance; warnings[] }
  | { outcome: "conditional"; branches[]; requiredFindings[]; scope; provenance }
  | { outcome: "insufficient_facts"; requiredInputs[]; candidates[]; scope }
  | { outcome: "abstained"; searched; nearestUnconfirmed[]; reason; referral? }
  | { outcome: "unsupported_scope"; requested; available[]; officialLinks[] }
  | { outcome: "official_source_conflict"; evidence[]; blockedAction }
  | { outcome: "professional_review_required"; value?; reasons[]; urgency? };

Problem details never include queries, evidence text, SQL, stack traces, provider messages, phone numbers or existence-sensitive object facts. Human text is localized; clients branch only on stable code and typed extension fields.

§9Audit
& challenge

A replay is a proof graph, not another model call

Hosted models are stochastic and aliases drift. Exact replay means presenting the stored provider response and verified artifact with the same pinned inputs, transformations and decisions—never asking a model to reproduce the text.

Audit elementMinimum fieldsIntegrity
AdmissionRequest id, actor class, legal scope, corpus/rule snapshots, client and API versions.Canonical JSON digest.
RetrievalParser, filters, candidates and all stage scores, graph paths, gate features/version/decision.Immutable trace reference.
GenerationContext digest, prompt artifact, provider/model snapshot, parameters, raw structured response, cost/timing.Encrypted body + digest.
VerificationClaim/evidence graph, deterministic and NLI checks, thresholds, verdicts, dropped claims and completeness result.Append-only verdict rows.
ReleaseExact returned bytes, SSE event journal, disclaimer, dependency set, artifact digest.Hash chain over events.
ChallengeUser reason, request id, consented snapshot, triage owner, root cause, invalidations, regression fixture.Attributed append-only actions.

A reviewer can immediately mark an artifact withdrawn, which blocks new reads and invalidates dependent cached/offline answers. Corrected artifacts are new versions; history is never overwritten. User feedback never edits prompts, labels, rules or the live corpus automatically.

§10Pakistan
legal posture

Engineer to enacted duties; label policy choices honestly

Pakistan has relevant constitutional, cybercrime, electronic-record, evidence and professional-conduct law, but the Ministry of IT still lists the Personal Data Protection Bill as a draft. The architecture adopts data-minimisation and user-control protections as product policy without misrepresenting a bill as binding legislation.

AuthorityWhat it supportsBackend consequenceDo not overclaim

10.1Data classes and lifecycle

ClassExamplesDefault lifecycle
PUBLICPromulgated sources, judgments, verified public metadata.Versioned indefinitely; corrections append; source bytes immutable.

Account deletion starts an auditable erasure workflow covering primary user tables, object artifacts, search/cache entries and encryption keys. Backups expire under their documented rotation; the live system retains a non-reversible deletion receipt. A legal hold must name authority, scope, approver and expiry. These are product controls pending a separately approved retention schedule—not invented statutory periods.

§11Jobs
& effects

Durable work is state; a background callback is not

Judgment summaries, document renders, pack builds, exports, notifications and large review jobs enter a PostgreSQL-backed queue in the same transaction as the command. FastAPI in-process background tasks are reserved for dispensable, content-free cleanup.

§12Two sync
engines

Signed authority flows down; user intent merges both ways

Corpus sync and user sync share HTTP infrastructure but no state machine. The corpus is server-authored evidence and never accepts a client write. User data is editable offline and therefore needs mutation identity, versions, tombstones and conflict semantics.

PropertyCorpus packsUser data
DirectionServer → device only.Device ↔ server.
TrustEd25519-signed manifest; per-object SHA-256; pinned public key.Authenticated actor + RLS + per-mutation id.
Cursorfrom_version to exact to_version; maximum chain 12.Server sequence, never device timestamp.
ConflictImpossible by design; device is not a writer.Last accepted server version wins per record; conflict returned for explicit user resolution where destructive.
DeleteSigned withdrawal/delete and dependent INVALIDATE operations.Tombstone retained through the documented multi-device window.
FailureReject whole patch, keep previous pack; long gap gets full pack.Accept valid mutations individually; return per-item results, then pull.
 
GET /v1/packs/manifest?from=1840&tiers=core,punjab
{ schema_version, from_version, to_version, built_at, expires_at,
  tiers[], patches:[{id,url,bytes,sha256}], invalidations[], signature, key_id }

POST /v1/user-sync/push
{ device_id, mutations:[{mutation_id, entity, entity_id, base_version, op, value}] }
→ { results:[{mutation_id,status,server_version,current?}], high_watermark }

GET /v1/user-sync/pull?after=<opaque-server-cursor>&limit=500
→ { records[], tombstones[], next_cursor, has_more }

Pack URLs are content-addressed and may be CDN-cached; manifests are short-lived and scope-aware. User-sync responses are private, non-cacheable and contain only the authenticated user’s rows. The anonymous dependency graph has neither engine.

§13Cost
& concurrency

Idempotency, quotas and caches carry legal scope

Controls are keyed by the semantic cost and risk of an operation. A single requests-per-minute rule would under-protect OTP and rendering while unnecessarily constraining statutory lookup.

Operation classPrimary dimensionsControl
OTP request/verifyNormalized phone HMAC, IP prefix, device session, challenge.Progressive cooldown, attempt ceiling, enumeration-safe response, abuse review.
Public law/searchEdge identity + session; cheap versus inference search.High read quota, query complexity and result caps, statement timeout.
Grounded answerAccount/anonymous session, entitlement, concurrent operations, provider tokens.Small concurrency limit, daily allowance, cost reservation before provider call.
Precedent graphDepth, date span, court filters, rows examined.Depth and node caps; no arbitrary graph query language.
Render/exportActor, document type, pages/bytes, active jobs.Idempotency, queue quota, sandbox budget and artifact expiry.
SyncAccount/device, records/bytes, cursor age.500-record pages, body limits, mutation dedupe, full-pack off-ramp.
ConsoleStaff identity, role, workflow and write risk.Low mutation rate, step-up assurance, revision precondition and audit.

13.1Idempotency

The key is bound to actor scope, route, API major and canonical request digest. Same key and digest returns the stored status/body; same key with another digest returns 409. In-flight duplicates wait briefly or receive 409 with the operation URL. Records expire after 24 hours for authenticated commands; anonymous keys live only in the ephemeral session.

13.2Caching

  • Exact legal cache keys include normalized input, explicit and inferred scope separately, exact as_of, corpus/rule/taxonomy versions, pipeline/model hashes, language, reading level, entitlements and degradation mode.
  • No shared cache for private query text, matters, drafts, user sync or review cases. Public immutable law may use CDN public, immutable; authenticated data uses private, no-store unless explicitly safe.
  • Semantic similarity may nominate a verified answer but cannot authorize reuse; L4’s equivalence, scope and dependency gates remain mandatory.
  • No Redis at pilot. Process-local LRU handles small public metadata; PostgreSQL owns shared idempotency, quotas, jobs and cache records. Add a network cache only after measured lock/contention evidence.

Metering is an append-only usage ledger separate from payment: actor/entitlement, operation class, reserved/actual units, provider cost and reversal. B2B API keys and charging stay disabled in v1, but scopes and units exist so institutional exposure later does not require rewriting authorization.

§14Security
& abuse

The threat model follows legal data and expensive capabilities

The dominant risks are horizontal access to another person’s matter, account takeover through phone recovery, resource exhaustion through AI/render endpoints, prompt-data exfiltration, malicious document content and misuse of curator/publisher powers.

ThreatPreventDetect / contain
Broken object authorizationPolicy on every lookup, RLS forced, non-enumerating private ids, signed download after check.Cross-owner canary tests, denied-access metrics, revoke session.
Mass assignmentStrict allow-listed commands; never bind persistence models from request JSON.Unknown-field 422 metric and schema fuzzing.
OTP/account recovery abuseOne-use challenges, progressive limits, delayed number change, privileged MFA.Velocity/risk events; family revocation; user notice.
Resource exhaustionBody, list, graph, token, concurrency, DB statement and worker budgets.Cost reservation, queue depth alerts, kill/cancel by request id.
Prompt injectionCorpus/user text is data-only, no tools in provider, allow-listed evidence handles, structured schema.Schema/handle violations; verification veto; provider isolated to L4.
Malicious source/uploadMIME and magic checks, size caps, quarantine, non-root sandbox, no network or shell.Scanner/extractor failure queue; destroy work directory.
SSRF / unsafe URLsNo user URL fetch. Official links come from reviewed registry; ingestion adapters enforce destination allow-lists.Outbound-deny network policy and DNS alerts.
Rule/corpus supply chainSeparate publisher role, reviewed manifest, locked tests, signing key outside API, dependency pinning.Signature verification, provenance audit, atomic rollback.
Sensitive telemetryContent-free attributes, phone HMAC only where required for abuse control, no prompt/answer capture.CI log scanner and production canaries.
Dependency compromiseLock file, hashes, minimal images, SBOM, signature/provenance checks, scheduled patching.Vulnerability alerts, image quarantine, reproducible rebuild.

Secrets arrive at runtime, never in source, images, Compose files or telemetry. Separate credentials exist for API, migrator, corpus publisher, workers and backup. The API has read-only corpus grants; the renderer has no database or network credential; the pack signer is absent from the API container.

Evidence preservation

Security response records hashes, UTC timestamps, actor/session identifiers, immutable public-resource ids and access events. It does not create an unrestricted copy of every user’s legal content. Incident evidence is separately authorized, encrypted, scoped and expired.

& degradation

Observe decisions without observing confidential text

Each request propagates W3C traceparent, uses the client request id as a searchable business correlation key and emits bounded OpenTelemetry spans. Queries, evidence, prompts, answers, party names, phone numbers and artifact URLs are forbidden attributes.

/health/live answers only whether the process event loop is responsive. /health/ready checks database, migrations, corpus publication, worker compatibility and signing/adapter configuration with tight timeouts; it returns coarse component classes rather than connection details. Startup fails closed on schema or contract incompatibility.

§16Runtime
& config

Stateless API processes; state and truth remain explicit

The production shape inherits Documents 09a and 09b: Python 3.12 slim image locked with uv, four Uvicorn workers on the pilot host, PostgreSQL as the only operational state store and R2/MinIO for content-addressed blobs.

  • Async routes perform I/O through async clients. CPU-bound embedding, reranking, verification and rendering never run in the API event loop.
  • Startup runs no migrations. A separate migrator role applies reviewed Alembic migrations before readiness. All schema objects and roles originate in migrations.
  • Configuration is typed, validated and printed only as a redacted fingerprint. Environment differences select adapters and enabled corpus scopes, never alternate business logic.
  • Graceful shutdown stops admission, drains short requests, marks streams reconnectable, returns unleased jobs and respects a bounded termination window.
  • Database pools have per-worker ceilings; transactions are short; long legal work pins version ids rather than holding snapshots open.
required configuration classes
Environment · Database · ObjectStore · Identity · SMS · LLMRoute
Inference · CorpusScope · RuleManifests · SigningPublicKeys
Limits · Retention · Telemetry · Features

Feature flags may route a cohort between already-qualified implementations. They may not lower a gate, skip verification, enable an unreviewed rule, change retention silently or expose a model/provider endpoint. Every safety-relevant flag has owner, reason, expiry, audit and kill switch.

§17Tests
& build

Build the safety spine before adding product breadth

The definition of done is not that Swagger opens. It is that an answer, abstention, calculator branch, pack patch and anonymous request each traverse their complete trust path under failures and remain explainable.

GateRequired proof
G1 boundariesImport-linter proves routes cannot import SQL repositories directly, L6 cannot import provider SDKs and no layer reaches past fixed ports.

G3 invariantsAbstention never calls generation; no block precedes verification/audit; anonymous graph has no durable writer; all legal reads carry as_of.
G4 identityOTP replay, brute force, enumeration, refresh reuse, revocation, recovery and assurance downgrade adversarial tests.

17.1Definition of done

  • Every operation in §7 exists in OpenAPI or is explicitly phase-gated; no undocumented route ships.
  • All five master invariants and QA-7, QA-8, QA-9, QA-10, QA-11, QA-12 and QA-13 have executable backend evidence.
  • Every domain inability survives transport without becoming a confident scalar, empty result or generic error.
  • Authenticated released answers replay exactly; anonymous requests leave no content behind; both use the same retrieval/generation verification gates.
  • Generated clients pass contract diff, the legal locked set has no critical regression, and rollback is rehearsed before pilot traffic.

& standards

Primary sources and implementation standards

Legal sources establish the risk posture; technical standards establish interoperable mechanisms. Product safeguards that go beyond current enacted Pakistani law are identified as policy choices, not attributed to a statute.

Client Architecture

§0Scope
& bounds

What L7 owns

L7 is a terminal layer: it reads, it never writes to the corpus, and it holds no authority over legal content. Its job is to present grounded material truthfully, to keep working when the network does not, and to be usable by someone who cannot comfortably read.
